title: Taking Back Our Lanes
summary: Our district has 30 private lanes trapped in fragmented ownership structures — preventing coordinated maintenance, lighting, or improvement. We are campaigning for Glasgow City Council to take statutory ownership and management responsibility, creating a coherent public realm for the first time.
details: Our area contains 30 private lanes in a patchwork of private and shared ownership. This fragmentation blocks any single body from taking responsibility for lighting, surfacing, or maintenance. We are building a formal case for Glasgow City Council to assume statutory management — the essential first step to creating a safe and coherent network of public lanes.
